info.title: KRONOS
info.description: Tools organized by caller and responsibility. All mutations are validated by the simulation engine and saved before broadcasting. Caller groups describe intended usage in one trusted local session; they are not authentication boundaries.

post.description: Parse supported text, validate the current version, then persist and broadcast.

Buy, sell, transfer, price, produce, consume, communicate, build, upgrade, or move.

The player chooses actor_id; the engine still enforces ownership, funds, and stock.
Adds a citizen on a plot. Starting money enters the economy from outside.

get.description:
Own state, role, public bakery prices, neighbor names, and runnable action types.

Read-only; this is the same observation /decide sends to the AI provider.

post.summary: Validate an agent proposal without committing it
post.description:
Dry-run against a copied world. Saves no events, state, snapshots, or RNG changes.

Validation is only valid for the returned sequence; execution rechecks that version.

post.summary: Submit an agent action for engine execution
post.description:
Require actor_id to match citizen_id, then validate, persist, and broadcast.

A rule rejection returns status "rejected" with an error code, and is saved as an
action_rejected event plus a memory for the agent. Stale versions still return 409.
Agents never mutate live state themselves; the full world arrives on WS /ws/world.

post.summary: Let the AI layer choose and submit this citizen's next action
post.description:
Observation → provider → the same path as POST /actions (logged even if rejected).

Returns 409 if the world changed while the provider was thinking, and 422 if the provider
fails or times out.

post.summary: Ask a citizen a question, answered from its own event history
post.description: Read-only. Answers may only cite events in which this citizen took part.

patch.summary: Shift a citizen's goal weights by at most 10 points each
patch.description: Submitted as an adjust_goals action; weights are clamped and renormalised to 100.

post.description: Capital (at least 5,000 cents) moves from the founder into the new business's cash.
Cash and goods return to the owner, employees are released, and the plot is freed.

post.summary: Advance the simulation by one day

post.description:
Use the same version, engine, and persistence checks as other action callers.

This endpoint grants no extra capabilities. In-process jobs may call
Service.execute_action directly instead of making an HTTP request to this server.
Persist a new village; explicitly activate its branch to start using it.

get.summary: Read the outcome of an agent action
get.description: Actions apply immediately, so this never reports "queued"; it rebuilds the result.

ActionResult.title: ActionResult
ActionResult.description:
Outcome of an agent action. Rule rejections are logged events, not HTTP errors.

Request problems (stale sequence, unknown citizen, malformed body) still fail with HTTP codes.
sequence is the world version after this result; send it as the next expected_sequence.

AdjustGoals-Input.title: AdjustGoals
AdjustGoals-Input.description: Shift goal weights by bounded deltas; the engine clamps and renormalises to 100.

AdjustGoals-Output.title: AdjustGoals
AdjustGoals-Output.description: Shift goal weights by bounded deltas; the engine clamps and renormalises to 100.

AgentObservation.title: AgentObservation
AgentObservation.description: Everything one agent may see: its own state plus public facts, never other citizens.

wage.title: Wage
wage.description: Paid to each employee per day

unpaid_days.title: Unpaid Days
unpaid_days.description: Consecutive days with a missed wage; 3 means bankruptcy

BusinessCommand.title: BusinessCommand
BusinessCommand.description: Convenience-route body. actor_id is the citizen acting (owner or buyer).

BusinessProfile.title: BusinessProfile
BusinessProfile.description:
A building plus values derived from the world. Employees are citizens whose
employer_id points here; there is no separate employee list to drift out of sync.

CitizenProfile.title: CitizenProfile
CitizenProfile.description: A citizen plus values derived from the world (role, tier, employment).

FoundBusiness-Input.title: FoundBusiness
FoundBusiness-Input.description: Fund a new business from the founder's money; capital becomes business cash.

FoundBusiness-Output.title: FoundBusiness
FoundBusiness-Output.description: Fund a new business from the founder's money; capital becomes business cash.

GoalWeightChanges-Output.title: GoalWeightChanges

Lend-Output.description: Loan offer; rate is basis points per term so money stays integral.
